historical_boundaries: The publication on Making Medicines Keep was accepted 15 October 2026; do not present it as already published.

The catalogue dates the composite volume to 715 AH / 1315–16 from the third treatise's colophon on fol. 139v; this does not independently date every leaf or show that the copy was produced in Cairo. Or 5786 is a manuscript witness, not an authorial autograph.
Source materials are documentary evidence of pharmaceutical practice and prescription formulations; they are not measured evidence of contemporary pharmacological efficacy.
An independent generic Wellcome Arabic medical manuscript cannot be represented as a leaf from British Library Or 5786 or a specific Cairo Genizah fragment.

notes: Exact Or 5786 source identified with public-domain usage term. A GitHub Actions access request returned HTTP 403; no physical folio JPEG was staged and the workflow was limited to manual authorized retries. Existing graphics remain labeled reconstructions. A second catalogued and freely reusable copy of the same actual text has been identified at Wellcome MS Arabic 1002 (1904); unlike generic Wellcome M0008126, it is genuinely Minhāj al-dukkān. Do not imply a page or copy date proves thirteenth-century production.
